title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.31731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequences often suffer from semantic inconsistency--exhibiting redundancy or conflicts within and across modalities--which hinders robust understanding and increases computational cost. To this end, we introduce ConsMSA, which explicitly formalizes semantic distribution consistency across both $\textit{intra}$- and $\textit{inter}$-modality, providing a consistency-aware mechanism for robust and efficient multimodal sentiment prediction. translated_title: ConsMSA：面向多模态情感分析的语义分布一致性学习
translated_abstract: 多模态情感分析（MSA）旨在通过整合文本、视频和音频等不同模态的信号来预测人类情感。然而，原始的多模态序列常常存在语义不一致问题——在模态内部和模态之间表现出冗余或冲突——这阻碍了对情感的鲁棒理解并增加了计算成本。为此，我们提出了ConsMSA，它显式地将模态内与模态间的语义分布一致性形式化，为鲁棒且高效的多模态情感预测提供了一种一致性感知机制。具体而言，ConsMSA将多模态token特征投影到共享的情感空间中，以计算模态内与模态间一致性得分（I²CS）。通过将该得分与预测相关性相结合，我们构建了一致性感知的重要性信号，并将其用于：(i) 作为一致性正则化器来对齐潜在分布……
tldr: 该论文提出ConsMSA，通过将多模态特征投影到共享情感空间并计算模态内与模态间一致性得分（I²CS），构建一致性感知的重要性信号来解决多模态序列中的语义不一致问题，从而提升多模态情感分析的鲁棒性与效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ConsMSA, which projects multimodal features into a shared sentiment space to compute an intra- and inter-modality consistency score (I²CS), generating consistency-aware importance signals to address semantic inconsistency in multimodal sequences and improve the robustness and efficiency of multimodal sentiment analysis.
